notes: All 27 converted STP meshes are retained at original positions in the neutral pose.

Seven action axes are independent of base DOA. No actual servo feedback or collision physics are implied.
Face video is contained within the actual front-cover mesh without changing its aspect ratio. Effective screen dimensions remain unconfirmed.
